name: Kentucky FFA
what_you_do: Students in farm and food classes join a school chapter. They compete in career events and go to FFA camp and the state convention. They can run for chapter and state leader jobs.
who_can_apply: Students enrolled in at least one agriculture course. The page says members are 12 to 21.
pay_detail: Dues are not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: No application date. Upcoming: State Land Judging Nov 5, 2026. The 98th State Convention has no date posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Chapter Locator on kyffa.org or ask your ag teacher. Phone 502-564-3472.
notes: 25,178 members in 186 chapters (per the page). Dues are not stated.
